# realuptime_notification_channel (Resource)

A notification channel in the account's registry (`POST /notification-channels`): a Discord webhook, a Microsoft Teams webhook, an Opsgenie integration, or a generic JSON endpoint (Zapier and the like). Attach it to alert rules from the dashboard. Email, Slack, plain webhooks and PagerDuty are configured on alert rules directly, not here. The credential in `config` is WRITE-ONLY: the API never returns it, so Terraform keeps the value you set and compares against that; `config_summary` is the redacted form the API does return. A new channel is unverified until a test send succeeds from the dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "discord_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "realuptime_notification_channel" "discord" {
  type = "discord"
  name = "Ops Discord"
  config = {
    webhookUrl = var.discord_webhook_url
  }
}

resource "realuptime_notification_channel" "opsgenie" {
  type = "opsgenie"
  name = "Opsgenie (EU)"
  config = {
    apiKey = var.opsgenie_api_key
    region = "eu"
  }
}

resource "realuptime_notification_channel" "zapier" {
  type    = "generic_json"
  name    = "Zapier hook"
  enabled = false
  config = {
    url = "https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/123/abc"
  }
}

variable "opsgenie_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/docsgen -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Map of String) Per-type settings, all string values. `discord` and `msteams`: `webhookUrl` (an https webhook URL on the vendor's own host). `generic_json`: `url` (https, public address). `opsgenie`: `apiKey` and `region` (`us` or `eu`). Replacing the config clears verification and the last test result. (Sensitive.)
- `name` (String) Display name, 1-120 characters, unique per account (RU-3009).
- `type` (String) One of `discord`, `msteams`, `opsgenie`, `generic_json` (`sms`, `voice`, `mobile_push` are reserved and refused today). Immutable: changing it replaces the channel.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) False soft-disables the channel: it delivers nothing but keeps its alert-rule attachments, so re-enabling restores them. Default true.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The owning account's id.
- `config_summary` (String) Redacted, human-readable description of the stored config (a URL origin, "EU region, API key stored"). Never the credential.
- `id` (String) Channel id (UUID).
- `provider_configured` (Boolean) Whether this build can actually deliver to the type (false for the reserved sms/voice/mobile_push stubs).
- `type_label` (String) The type's display label (e.g. "Microsoft Teams").
- `verified_at` (String) When a test send last succeeded against the CURRENT config; null until one has.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import by channel id. The credential is never readable, so the next plan
# shows `config` being set from your configuration (one in-place update).
terraform import realuptime_notification_channel.discord 44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444
```
